headline: Revenue and profit both improve versus the prior quarter
summary_short: Haier Smart Home's Q2 2026 revenue was CNY78.43B, up 1.36% y/y, with EPS of CNY0.54 up 8.0% q/q from CNY0.50 in Q1.
summary_long: Q2 revenue reached CNY78.43B, up 1.36% y/y, and the company said Q2 revenue and net profit attributable to shareholders were both higher than in Q1. H1 gross margin rose 0.4ppt y/y to 27.2%. Smart HVAC Solutions, the largest disclosed segment, grew H1 revenue 6.1% y/y with segment profit up 26.8% y/y, management crediting pooled R&D, supply chain, and channel resources. No explicit forward guidance was stated in the release.
confidence_notes: Q2-isolated figures are limited on the release — most detail is disclosed on an H1 cumulative basis; EPS is the shard's verified Q2 figure while revenue is the release's own Q2-isolated figure.

drivers.explanation: Company states Q2 revenue and net profit were both higher than Q1, without isolating a specific single cause beyond broad segment momentum.
Smart HVAC Solutions segment profit rose 26.8% y/y on pooled R&D, supply chain and channel resources bringing products to market more efficiently.
